legal_reviewer_reference.rule: Must identify a real independent legal/privacy review authority; preparation cannot self-attest it.

approved_privacy_notice_document.rule: Real approved privacy notice artifact; receipt stores only SHA-256.

approved_privacy_notice_version.rule: Explicit reviewed version bound to publication.

stable_published_privacy_url.rule: Stable public production privacy route; placeholder, local, staging and preview routes rejected.

effective_date.rule: Explicit reviewed effective date; collector never infers it.

international_transfer_review_artifact.rule: Reviewed transfer analysis must exist even when the conclusion is not-applicable.

international_transfer_applicability.rule: Applicability must come from reviewed evidence, never inference by the collector.

encarregado_or_exemption_contact_review_.rule: Reviewed encarregado, lawful exemption and/or contact-channel determination artifact.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: COLLECT_DIGEST_ONLY_RECEIPT
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Hash real reviewed artifacts and record only non-sensitive metadata; no network/database mutation.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: INDEPENDENTLY_REVIEW_RECEIPT_AND_SOURCE_ARTIFACTS
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Confirm review authority, publication/version, inventory, retention, transfer and encarregado/contact evidence.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: PROMOTE_DEDICATED_EVIDENCE_MIGRATION
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Only after real review, create a separate versioned migration updating exactly legal_privacy_notice with evidence_ref and evidence_digest.

next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.name: MERGE_GREEN_THEN_APPLY_ONCE
next_sequence_after_valid_real_evidence.rule: Apply exact merged evidence migration via Supabase.apply_migration only; execute_sql remains SELECT-only.
